purpose: Every hook into the running game the chrome stands on. One row per hook. Nothing is used that is not listed here.

rows.system: PlayerGameData (level, attributes, runes, HP/FP/stamina maxima) and the damage pipeline
rows.api: fromsoftware-rs eldenring crate; PlayerGameData fields; damage-hook on the character damage path
rows.risk: medium - writing maxima can desync the HUD

rows.api: hook the damage path; read and adjust incoming and outgoing values
rows.risk: medium - wrong offsets crash at combat start

rows.system: Hit confirmation on the player's landed hits
rows.api: same damage hook, player-as-attacker branch; counts hits for Microgenerator and crits for Bioconductor
the game's time scale value, driven per frame; player-side speed kept at full
rows.risk: high - the engine runs game logic off this

rows.system: Equipped weapon behaviour (reach, arc, speed, bleed)
rows.api: weapon behaviour fields on the player's equipped weapon instance
CSBulletManager bullet spawn with a bullet row from the player's regulation.bin
rows.risk: medium - needs a param row; wrong row crashes

rows.api: steer an in-flight bullet toward the locked target each frame
WorldChrMan character list: position, HP, hostility, distance for markers and targeting
ChrIns team field - Overturn makes the target hostile to its own squad
rows.risk: medium - can leave an NPC permanently hostile to everything

rows.system: Status effects already in the game (bleed, frost, lightning, poison, unseen form, heal)
rows.api: apply an existing Elden Ring SpEffect by id from the player's vanilla params; no new params shipped
CSChrPhysicsModule position and velocity for double jump and jump height
rows.risk: high - the game applies its own gravity; the CS2 note records fall death from exactly this

rows.api: HP write for Blood Pump and Biomonitor; the death flow for Second Heart
rows.risk: medium - reviving wrongly can leave the character stuck

rows.api: apply the game's own unseen-form effect for Optical Camo; slow the awareness build for Lynx Paws
DirectInput GetDeviceState hook (the game never calls GetDeviceData); our keys only
hudhook ImGui overlay in the D3D12 frame for the HUD, bench and hack menu
ImGui draws projected from world positions read through chr_ins; no game UI touched
plain JSON under the mod folder, written on install, swap and rest
